To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the genotype LSb 1 and PK 1029 were found to be stable and superior for seed yield per plot, and LSb 1 was stable and superior for all the component characters studied.
The stability of genotypes was studied for grain yield and various other agronomic characters in soybean.
The genotypes LSb3, LSb1, PK1029, MAC450, JS335 and LSb5 were identified as stable for seed yield, and other component characters in different seasons.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a study of the stability and yield performance of 8 geno-types of soybean grown in three different environments (seasons).
the stability analysis for some characters in Soybean grown over different seasons.
the development of a method for the determination of the stability of the characters of soybean grown in different environments.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the genotype LSb 1 was found to be the most stable and suitable genotype for all the characters studied.
the genotype LSb 1 was found to be the most stable and promising for seed yield, and other characters.
LSb 3 is a stable and high yielding genotype for the Punjab region, whereas LSb 1 is a stable and suitable genotype for KPK and Balochistan regions.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the genotypes LS 1, PK1029, MAC 450 and JS335 are suitable for cultivation under all seasons.
the genotypes LSB 3, LSb 1 and MACS 450 are stable for seed yield and other component traits.
the genotypes PK 1029 and LSb 1 are suitable for cultivation in the Kandi area, while genotypes MACS 450, LSb 3, JS 335 and LSb 2 may be suitable for cultivation in other seasons.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the stability of genotypes is not only important but it can be achieved through selection.
the stability of a particular genotype for a character is not always associated with its yield performance.
the genotypes LS 3, PK 102, LS 1 and MACS 450 can be used in the future as stable genotypes for different environments and for different seasons.
